additional_info.subject: RE: 0398390 - ID0398390-DC/Si-D/BE- [MP / R2 170001525] Very unstable outlets on the charger CRM:02023000405
additional_info.body:
Dear Marnic Segers,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0398390 ﻿from the eMobility DC Queue (Level 2) to the eMobility RC-BE SI E Queue (Level 2), due to one or more following reason (s):
Refer below schematics for troubleshooting
Power off the system to ensure safety.
Locate the CAN_H, CAN_L, and Ground wires.
Ensure 120-ohm termination resistors are at both ends of the bus.
Use a multimeter to measure resistance:
Between CAN_H and CAN_L, check for 60 ohms in the middle or 120 ohms at the ends.
Check for shorts: There should be no continuity between CAN_H and Ground, CAN_L and Ground, or between CAN_H and CAN_L.
Verify wiring and resistors are properly installed and undamaged.
Additionally, you may carry one spare KF11 at site if above activities didn't resolved the issue and you may try replacing the KF11 and check if it resolves the issue.
Here are details for ordering KF11
Order Code - 8EM5903-0AA00-6AA3 also here you can find more about spare parts:
